title: 40Hz Auditory Entrainment
description: EEG recordings from elderly participants with dementia during 40 Hz auditory stimulation designed to entrain brain oscillations in the gamma band. The stimulus was a 5 kHz carrier tone amplitude modulated by a 40 Hz pulse train, presented in short (six-trial) and long (ten-trial) sessions with interleaved rest. The dataset supports investigation of gamma entrainment as a potential intervention for Alzheimer's disease-related symptoms.
methods_description: 19-channel EEG was recorded using the 10/20 system at 250 Hz with impedance below 20 kΩ. References were the earlobes for short sessions and FCz for long sessions, with average referencing applied during preprocessing. Participants sat with eyes open in a quiet room. Auditory stimuli were generated in MATLAB and played through two speakers placed 50 cm from the participant. Each trial lasted 40 s and was followed by 20 s of silence.
